holidays.name: International Hat Day
holidays.description: Put on a hat and wear it all day. Baseball cap, fedora, beanie, top hat, or a wizard hat you found in a costume bin all count. It's a good excuse to let your head make a statement.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial observance of unclear origin. It has become a popular day to celebrate headwear and the part it has played in fashion, culture and everyday life.
holidays.funFact: Hats have never been only about style. Through history they have shown social rank, shielded people from the weather and marked whole professions, from chefs to kings.

holidays.name: Shopping Reminder Day
holidays.description: This is a friendly nudge, one month before Christmas, to make your gift list and check it twice. Pick up a pen, plan your budget and decide who is getting socks this year.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial observance of unclear origin. It falls on November 25 each year as a reminder that the festive season is about a month away.
holidays.funFact: The day usually lands in the middle of the biggest shopping weekend of the year, so it works as a pep talk for people who are about to hit the stores.
